title: Vegan Ethiopian Tagine with Quick Lentil Stew
description: A quick and energizing vegan Ethiopian-inspired stew made with lentils and spices, served with a tagine
instructions: Heat the oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the berbere spice, cumin, salt, and pepper; cook for 1 minute.
Add the lentils and 2 cups of water; bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20-25 minutes or until the lentils are tender.
Stir in any additional spices as desired.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
